dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: I'm the helmsman of this ship. I never leave my post on voyage.

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: If we have sudden encounters with reefs or whirlpools, I must be able to act swiftly. I can't afford to slacken my watch.

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: It's not an easy job, but it's always been my dream to do this.
